## LO-08 Dashboard API
Read API for the Next.js dashboard (spec §10 WF08, contracts/api.md). Every route needs `x-lo-key`.
Each row: Webhook → Data Table reads (by `user_id`) → Code (`lib/projection.mjs`, pasted verbatim) → one shared **Respond** node that sends `{ ok, data }` or `{ ok:false, error }` with the HTTP status.
**No polling:** the dashboard calls these on page load and button press only.
**Alpaca Paper** (prices + clock) and **Frankfurter** (FX) are optional: on any error the Code falls back to last fill prices, `market_open: null` and config `fx_fallback_usdcad`. Positions are always derived from the user's own `orders` rows, because every user shares one paper account.
